explanation.en:
〜ことができる expresses ability. It means “can do” or “be able to.” It is made by using the dictionary form + ことができる.

Key points:
• Dictionary form + ことができる
• Means ability or possibility
• Polite form: 〜ことができます
• Common with skills like speaking or playing

For example, “日本語を話すことができます” means “I can speak Japanese.” “泳ぐことができます” means “I can swim.”

You can also use it to say something is possible: “ここで写真を撮ることができます” means “You can take photos here.”

This pattern is very regular and useful. It is different from できます alone because it attaches to a specific verb.

As a beginner, remember to keep the verb in dictionary form before こと. This makes the phrase a noun-like action that can be “possible.”

structure.pattern: Verb (dictionary form) + ことができます

examples.japanese: 日本語を話すことができます。
examples.romaji: Nihongo o hanasu koto ga dekimasu.

examples.japanese: ここで写真を撮ることができます。
examples.romaji: Koko de shashin o toru koto ga dekimasu.

examples.japanese: 漢字を読むことができます。
examples.romaji: Kanji o yomu koto ga dekimasu.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using ます-form before ことができます
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 話しますことができます → ✅ 話すことができます

commonMistakes.correction: Keep こと to nominalize the verb
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 話すができます → ✅ 話すことができます
